home.title: Welcome to RawSeed
home.subtitle: Wholesome oils for healthy living
home.description: At RawSeed, we believe in the natural goodness of quality oils. Founded in Great Britain, we specialise in sourcing and supplying premium cold-pressed sesame, flaxseed and black seed oils under our flagship brand, Golden Drop — bringing tradition, quality and natural goodness to every bottle.

sesame_oil.title: Sesame Oil
sesame_oil.subtitle: Pure oil from Afghan soil
sesame_oil.description: At RawSeed, we believe in using ingredients that have stood the test of time. Sesame oil is one of the oldest, most nourishing oils known to humankind—yet it remains underused in modern kitchens. Here's why we think it’s time for sesame oil to reclaim its place in your pantry.

description.p1: RawSeed began with a simple question: What if cooking oils could retain more of the natural qualities that have made them valued for generations?
description.p2: We set out to offer an alternative to heavily processed and refined cooking oils, bringing carefully selected cold-pressed oils to consumers who value quality, simplicity and natural goodness. Inspired by traditional methods and generations of knowledge, RawSeed was established to source and supply oils that combine authentic taste with trusted quality.
description.p3: Our roots are closely connected to cultures where natural foods, traditional ingredients and time-honoured practices have long been valued. Drawing inspiration from these traditions, we explored traditional oil-pressing practices and the ways natural oils have been produced and enjoyed for generations.
description.p4: Today, we work with trusted producers and suppliers to carefully source our oils, beginning with sesame, flaxseed and black seed oils made from carefully selected seeds
description.p5: We believe that great oil starts with great ingredients. By respecting the character of the seeds and choosing quality over unnecessary processing, we aim to bring naturally distinctive oils to kitchens through our flagship brand, Golden Drop.

history.title: The History of Sesame Oil
history.p1: Sesame oil has been used for over 4,000 years. Civilisations across Asia, the Middle East, and Africa valued sesame oil for cooking, but also for medicine, skincare and spiritual rituals.
history.p2: In Ayurveda and traditional Chinese medicine, sesame oil has long been revered for its healing, detoxifying and balancing properties. It was known as the "queen of oils."
history.p3: Today, we’re proud to continue this tradition through Golden Drop — our premium, cold-pressed sesame oil.

p1.title: Bold Flavour, Natural Goodness
p1.description: Sesame oil has a warm, nutty flavour that adds depth and aroma to any dish. Use it in cooking, salad dressings, dips, marinades and stir-fries, or simply drizzle it over roasted vegetables or warm bread.

p2.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
p2.description: Cold-pressed sesame oil is rich in monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats, the kind that help lower bad cholesterol and support overall cardiovascular health.

p3.title: Naturally Rich in Antioxidants
p3.description: Packed with compounds like sesamol, sesamin, and vitamin E, sesame oil helps protect your body from oxidative stress while supporting skin and cellular health.

p4.title: High Smoke Point
p4.description: Whether sautéing, roasting or finishing a dish, sesame oil holds up beautifully in the kitchen thanks to its stable structure and high smoke point.

p5.title: Sustainable Minimal
p5.description: Sesame seeds are drought-resistant and grow with minimal inputs, making sesame oil a more sustainable choice compared to many mass-produced oils.

story.title: The Legacy of Black Seed

p1.sentence1: Black seed oil is pressed from the seeds of
p1.sentence3: , a flowering plant native to south and southwest Asia. These tiny black seeds—also known as black cumin, kalonji, or
p1.sentence5: (the blessed seed)—have been used for over 2,000 years in traditional healing systems like Unani, Ayurveda and Islamic medicine.

story.p2: It was found in the tomb of King Tutankhamun, praised by Hippocrates and referred to in Hadith as a remedy for “every disease except death.”
story.p3: At RawSeed, we extract this oil using traditional cold-pressing methods, without heat or chemicals, to preserve its full potency and purity.

story.title: The Golden Elixir for Culinary Delights

description.p1: In the world of wellness and sustainability, cold-pressed flaxseed oil is a versatile powerhouse, harvested from tiny yet mighty flax seeds. Unlike refined oils that undergo high-heat processing, our cold-pressed method gently extracts the oil at low temperatures, preserving its natural integrity and locking in a treasure trove of nutrients. This pure, unadulterated approach ensures you get the full spectrum of benefits: golden hues, a subtle nutty flavour and an abundance of health-boosting compounds that heat-sensitive alternatives simply can't match.
description.p2: Central to flaxseed oil's appeal is its exceptional nutrient profile, preserved by the cold-pressing technique. It's brimming with alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), a plant-based omega-3 fatty acid that makes up over 50% of its composition. This essential nutrient supports heart health by helping to lower cholesterol and reduce inflammation, while antioxidants like lignans combat oxidative stress for overall vitality. The cold-pressed process safeguards these delicate elements from degradation, delivering higher levels of vitamins E and B, along with minerals that promote glowing skin and strong hair. No solvents, no additives—just nature's finest in every drop.
description.p3: What sets cold-pressed flaxseed oil apart is its role as an eco-friendly alternative to animal-based omega-3 sources like fish oil. For vegans, vegetarians or anyone seeking sustainable options, it provides a clean, plant-derived source of essential omega-3s without the environmental concerns tied to overfishing or potential contaminants in marine sources. Backed by studies showing ALA's conversion to EPA and DHA in the body, cold-pressed flaxseed aligns with lifestyles focused on plant-based nutrition.

use_cases.title: Elevate Your Meals with Nutrient-Rich Flavour
use_cases.p1: Cold-pressed flaxseed oil is a culinary gem and a skincare essential. Its mild, nutty flavor enhances salads, smoothies, and dips, while its nourishing properties make it a favorite for moisturizing skin and strengthening hair. Whether drizzled over dishes or applied topically, this oil offers a natural boost for overall wellness.

smoothie.title: Smoothie Boost for Daily Wellness
smoothie.description: Blend a tablespoon into your morning green smoothie with spinach, banana, and almond milk. This simple addition infuses your routine with omega-3s to support brain function and sustained energy, helping you tackle the day with focus and vitality—perfect for busy professionals reaping anti-inflammatory benefits over time.

salad.title: Salad Dressing Delight
salad.description: Whisk it with lemon juice, Dijon mustard, and herbs for a zesty vinaigrette over fresh greens. Consumers love this for heart-healthy meals, as the preserved lignans aid digestion and may even assist in weight management, making it a go-to for those prioritizing clean eating and long-term cardiovascular support.

skin_health.title: Skincare Secrets; Nourish from the Outside In
skin_health.description: Beyond the kitchen, cold-pressed flaxseed oil is a skincare saviour, harnessing its nutrient density. Its lightweight texture absorbs quickly, hydrating the skin without greasiness.

skin.title: Moisturizing Face Serum
skin.description: Mix a few drops with your favourite carrier oil or apply directly to damp skin after cleansing. The high ALA content soothes irritation and balances oil production, ideal for acne-prone or mature skin types seeking reduced fine lines and a radiant glow. Users often notice improved texture and elasticity within weeks.

hair.title: Hair and Scalp Treatment
hair.description: Massage into your scalp before shampooing or add to a DIY hair mask with yogurt and honey. This harnesses the oil's vitamins to combat dryness and promote shine, benefiting those with flaky scalps or brittle strands by strengthening from root to tip, all while providing a natural alternative to synthetic conditioners.
